shortDescription: China’s latest economic stimulus package appears aimed at keeping growth on target rather than driving a wider rebound, according to Bloomberg.The measures leave underlying weakness in domestic demand largely unaddressed.

title: China Stimulus Seen Supporting Growth Target, Not Broader Recovery
